core_job: For US Schedule C drivers (rideshare/delivery, real-estate agents, home-care and field-service contractors): log every work drive with a defensible record and hand over the tax year's log. Tap Start drive, lock the phone, drive. Tap Stop and choose Business, Commute, Personal, Medical or Charity, with a written business purpose. Each trip is rated at the IRS rate for the date it was driven, including the 2026 mid-year change (72.5c Jan-Jun, 76c from Jul 1, checked on irs.gov on 2026-10-12). Export any tax year as a PDF and CSV. What exists today and stays: GPS distance, the SQLite log, manual and odometer entry, PDF/CSV export. What is broken: rates stop at 2025, so every 2026 total shows the 'This build ships no 2026 rate' warning; recording stops when the screen locks; there is no tax-year export, no search or filter, and no commute category.
signature: Records check, per tax year, on-device only. It does two things. (1) It fills in the vehicle figures for Schedule C Part IV / Form 4562 Part V: line 43 placed-in-service date, 44a business miles, 44b commuting miles, 44c other miles, and the business-use %, computed from the log plus dated odometer readings. (2) It lists every entry missing an element IRS Pub 463 Table 5-1 asks for: a business trip with no written purpose; a destination that is only coordinates or missing; a trip entered more than 7 days after the drive (Pub 463's weekly 'timely kept' rule); a GPS stretch that was estimated; a missing Jan 1 or Dec 31 odometer reading. Each gap is fixed in one tap, and the result prints as page 1 of the PDF. Competitor check: the iTunes Search API (store descriptions only; WebSearch disabled; the apps were not run) shows MileIQ, Everlance, Stride, Driversnote, TripLog and Mile Logger all claim IRS-compliant or audit-ready logs. Driversnote already offers a work/personal % split. None of the six descriptions mentions per-entry gap checks or Schedule C line values. Mile Logger quotes only the $0.725 rate. How these apps behave beyond their descriptions is not verified.
